title: pourouma bicolor subsp. tessmannii
intro: Pourouma bicolor subsp. tessmannii, commonly known as Pourouma tessmannii, is a species of plant in the family Chrysobalanaceae. It is a plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Pourouma tessmannii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of Pourouma tessmannii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
